rev: Plan Review Application Form for Stationary Food Establishments (Updated April 2025)
notes: Philadelphia Office of Food Protection's plan review application for stationary food establishments (pages 31 to 36 of the packet), with Schedule A (finishes) and Schedule B (equipment). Lists that say 'check all that apply' take every item that applies, by name. In this PDF the 'food safety certified individual' question shares its radio group with the category of application, and 'outside dumpster' shares one with 'tobacco is sold', so the first of each pair is answered by hand. The menu is attached; the signature and its date are left for the applicant.
